full_judgment: 2. Respondents instituted Title Suit No. 9 of 1985 in the Court of Munsif, Gangni, District, Meherpur seeking partition of the suit property claiming 6 annas share on refusal by the defendants too partition amicably. The suit on contest was decreed by the trial court. The defendants' appeal against the decree was dismissed leading to filing the revisional application in the High Court Division. The learned Single Judge of the High Court Division summarily rejected the application on the findings that no application under Order 41 Rule 27 C. P. C was filed in the court of appeal below and that the courts below on evidence concurrently found possession of the disputed land-With the plaintiffs.
